cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded travel card with Scapia rewarding hotel and airline bookings with accelerated points, while offering travel vouchers and lifestyle perks.

mileStoneItems.benefits: Up to 5,000 Scapia Coins (worth ₹1,000) for dining, shopping, or spa at select airports.

The spend requirement of ₹50,000 is fulfilled only through international flight bookings made via the Scapia app. Enjoy duty-free shopping or dining at international terminals in India and get up to 10,000 Scapia Coins (worth ₹2,000).
